answer: Single-use challenge admission makes every agent answer a fresh puzzle seeded by the ledger head, so the same response cannot register twice and a copied answer dies at the gate like water through shale. The coordinator checks first-seen uniqueness and exact challenge binding, rejecting replays; only a current answer can cross the canyon. An attacker pays per identity one solved challenge before expiry plus cloud CPU/GPU time and contention premium—compute, not copper—so mass registration scales with fresh work rather than cheap keys.
